full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a dark-haired man looking down, his face and upper torso emerging from a nearly black interior. The background is a deep blue-black field with faint uneven strokes, so the figure appears close and isolated. Thick wavy hair falls across his forehead, and the side of his face catches a concentrated orange-gold light. His brow, nose, cheek, and short dark beard are modeled in irregular warm strokes against the shadowed side. The eyes are directed downward and partly concealed beneath the brow, giving the expression a quiet, inward quality. A pale open-collar shirt shows at the center, marked with warm pink and cool blue-gray paint; a narrow black tie hangs loosely down from the collar. Over it he wears a dark teal jacket, its broad lapel and shoulders merging gradually with the dark ground. The lower torso is cropped by the frame, while the head sits high and slightly left of center. The paint is visibly worked: broken edges, coarse layered brush marks, and small color changes build the face and clothing rather than a smooth photographic surface. Some highlights are dense and opaque, while dark passages reveal thin, scumbled strokes. A strong warm light arrives from the upper left, striking the forehead and cheek before falling quickly into cool shadow across the right side and jacket. The overall composition is intimate and dramatic, with a small area of warm flesh color held inside a much larger envelope of textured darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形绘画肖像，一位黑发男子低头，面部和上半身从近乎黑色的室内环境中浮现。背景是一片深蓝黑色域，带有细微不均的笔痕，使人物显得贴近而孤立。厚密卷发落在额前，脸的一侧接住集中的橙金色光。眉骨、鼻、面颊和短深色胡须以不规则暖色笔触塑形，与阴影一侧对照。双眼朝下，部分藏在眉下，使神情安静而内向。中央露出的浅色敞领衬衫上有暖粉与冷蓝灰色颜料痕迹；一条细黑领带从衣领松松垂下。外面是深青绿色夹克，宽翻领和肩部逐渐融入深色背景。下半身被画框裁去，头部位于较高位置，略偏中央左侧。颜料加工痕迹明显：断续边缘、粗糙叠层笔触和细小色差构成面部与衣服，而非平滑摄影表面。有些高光厚实不透明，暗处则露出薄薄的擦涂痕。强烈暖光从左上方照来，击中前额和脸颊，随后迅速落入右侧脸和外套上的冷调阴影。整体构图亲密而富于戏剧性，让一小片暖色肤色被更大范围的带肌理黑暗包围。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted treatment builds form from broad broken strokes, scumbled dark layers, and concentrated opaque highlights. A deep teal and blue-black field occupies most of the surface, while a small warm zone of ochre, rust, and pink provides the visual focus. Edges alternate between assertive brush-cut marks and passages that dissolve into the surrounding dark, producing depth through selective visibility. Light falls strongly from one upper side and drops away quickly, leaving large low-value areas with subtle pigment variation. Cool and warm strokes sit beside one another inside lit forms, keeping the surface lively rather than smoothly blended. The framing is close and cropped, with asymmetrical light directing attention into the center of a broad textured shadow. The mood is restrained, intimate, and dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画处理以宽大断续笔触、擦涂的深色层和集中的不透明高光塑造形体。深青绿与蓝黑色域占据大部分表面，一小片赭色、锈红和粉色暖区成为视觉焦点。边缘在果断的刷切笔痕与消融于周围暗色的区域之间交替，通过选择性显现产生纵深。光从上方一侧强烈落下，又迅速衰减，使大片低明度区域保留细微颜料变化。被照亮的形体内部，冷暖笔触相邻，使表面活跃而非平滑调和。框取贴近且有裁切，不对称光线把注意力引入宽广带肌理阴影中的中央。氛围克制、亲密，富于戏剧性。
theme_en: A dark-haired man looking downward in warm side light
theme_zh: 暖侧光中低头的黑发男子
name: David Palumbo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
